proposed_capability: MoonWake /the-closers P83 independent review of merged PR #221 finds that the VAE's model filename is scoped to game/save/lot/build/graph but not to the active installation-profile id; even though profile-specific consent can differ, two local profiles can mutate/read/purge the same model. Repair by isolating the profile-selected local checkpoint and explicit CLI profile resolution while keeping default-profile legacy file identity unchanged. Clarify observation and score proof limitations; no new game observer or execution effects.
player_save_control_impact: No background capture, network, game input, OS changes, EA game files or save mutation. Existing default-profile local model filename and data preserved in place. Named profiles get separate opaque hashed checkpoint names, consent checked in the selected installation profile, no fallback into another profile. Explicit purge targets only a selected profile + world context. No automatic migration or deletion.
expected_outcome: Per-installation profile A/B with same save/lot cannot see/train/purge the other's learned model. CLI train, status and purge select the active or explicit existing profile consistently; enabled default remains off, and earlier default-profile files remain readable. Tests include independent CLI dispatch, symlink/lock/replay regressions, no game effects. Proof ceiling remains static/offline only.
negative_tests: Named profile with same save cannot read default checkpoint
Named profile disable cannot train even if default enabled
Profile A cannot delete profile B model
Explicit wrong or missing profile fails closed
Unknown profile IDs do not introduce arbitrary path segments
Default legacy checkpoint retains exact original path
CLI consent and profile dispatch backed by tests
No host capture or execution installed
rollback_path: Revert closers PR; no on-disk migration, original default path and all named-profile models remain unless explicitly purged. Never remove/migrate existing user data silently.
unresolved_unknowns: P08 local Windows Sims/EA source observation remains unproved
VAE usefulness on game geometry not yet independently measured with real samples
P04 actual host adapter dispatch unavailable in connector; only bounded handoff
Prior prototype's holdout metric is a research-only prequential proxy not evidence of improved Sims gameplay
decision_rationale: P83 source/readback of PR #221 locates profile collision in _local_path/record_if_enabled and CLI status/purge, not in the spatial-convolution sensor. P03 should repair existing bounded owner. P141 considered entire new storage engine (reject scope), split sensors (defer to P08 game host), and profile-keyed filenames with default compatibility (select). P124 keeps storage in semantic_vae/installation_profiles, P04 routes genuine game-host adapter as unproven local gate.
